title: 2004 ZAMAC First Editions
summary: In 2004, a selection of the 100 First Editions for the year were released as unpainted 'ZAMAC' models. These were a Toys R Us exclusive, although some also appeared at Target. The Splittin' Image ('Tooned) & Bedlam are the only cars (and only ZAMAC) to have Grey Plastic bodies instead of Unpainted Metal bodies.

title: Hot Wheels: Beat That!
summary: Hot Wheels: Beat That! is a racing video game released in September 2007 and based on the Hot Wheels toy line manufactured by Mattel. The game was developed by Eutechnyx and published by Activision.

title: Hot Wheels: Turbo Racing
summary: Hot Wheels Turbo Racing is a racing video game released for the Nintendo 64 and PlayStation in 1999 published by Electronic Arts and developed by Stormfront Studios. It features 40 cars based on the Hot Wheels series of toys by Mattel. It also features Kyle Petty's 1999 NASCAR stock car, as it was sponsored by Hot Wheels.
